Refactor notifications page UI & behavior
Simplify and reorganize the learner notifications page: remove search/filters/delete actions and related state, streamline notification mapping, and improve accessibility and loading/empty states.
Key changes: - Removed unused imports and components (Search Input, several lucide icons). - Dropped complex type/category mapping and fields from the UI Notification shape; mapNotificationToUI now only maps id/title/message/date/time/read. - Removed search/filter UI and related state; notifications are shown as a simple list with loading/empty states. - Mark notifications as read on item click (and via keyboard Enter/Space) using useMarkNotificationAsRead; kept mark-all-as-read action. - Simplified card styles and layout for responsiveness and clarity. - Use unread count to show header summary; improved loading/empty visuals.
Notes: This is a behavioral/UX refactor—removes delete and category-based filtering and changes Notification interface shape in the component. Adjust callers if they relied on the removed fields or behaviors.
